studies.title: Unveiling the future water pulse of central asia: a comprehensive 21st century hydrological forecast from stochastic water balance modeling
studies.study_area: 221 high-mountain Central Asian catchments over five large river basins, including Amu Darya and Syr Darya; catchments greater than 200 km2
sources: CHELSA V2.1 daily baseline temperature and precipitation
four CMIP6 GCMs under SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5, SSP3-7.0 and SSP5-8.5
Marti et al. 2023 gauge norms and catchment geometry
Rounce et al. 2023 glacier ablation projections
studies.method: Steady-state stochastic soil moisture water-balance model; runoff coefficient as function of aridity and storage indices; glacier imbalance ablation added to modeled discharge; GCM ensemble and catchment median reporting
studies.original_code: Zenodo CODE_ZENODO.zip, 327.4 kB, listed publicly; not downloaded in this first pass
studies.original_data: Zenodo DATA_ZENODO.zip, 2.5 GB, listed publicly; not downloaded or verified in this first pass
studies.published_target: Regional median modeled specific-discharge change for 2071-2100 under SSP5-8.5 versus modeled 1979-2011 baseline: -2.7%; article section 3.3, Figure 5/Table 2 context
studies.blocking_evidence: Full author input data and code archives have not been acquired, checksum-verified, or inspected; published aggregate alone cannot independently recreate the 221 catchment model inputs or ensemble median.
